Subject: Onboarding evidence and chain-of-custody ask (Harbor Bank SOC2)

Hi David,

We're starting a SOC 2 review focused on onboarding/offboarding controls. Can you share a small sample set of artifacts that demonstrates Redwood's approach to personnel screening and training? Specifically we need:

- A manifest listing a 10-person sample (hire date, role, background check vendor + completion date)
- Evidence that background checks were completed and how PII was handled for redaction
- The chain-of-custody/log showing when credentials/access were provisioned and later deprovisioned (timestamps and actors)
- Training completion records for the sample cohort (courses + dates)

We don't need full personally identifiable data — hashed or redacted IDs are fine. Please indicate expected delivery timeline; our internal reviewers prefer consolidated PDFs or a single zipped bundle with a manifest that maps files to sample IDs.

Thanks,
Bethany
Bethany Cole
Senior Security Manager — Harbor Bank
security@harborbank.com

Hi Bethany and team — attaching the requested sample artifacts. Notes below and an index is included in onboarding_manifest.csv.

Attachments (stubbed filenames):
- onboarding_manifest.csv — includes hashed_employee_id, hire_date, role, bg_check_vendor, bg_check_completion_date, training_courses
- background_checks_summary.pdf — redacted confirmation pages; vendor name + completion timestamps preserved; PII fields redacted; redaction_matrix.xlsx lists original fields and redaction method
- redaction_matrix.xlsx — mapping of PII fields -> redaction approach (hash/replace/strip) and justification for each field

A few implementation notes:
- For the chain-of-custody we included an excerpted access log for the sample hires (provisioning events, deprovisioning events, user id of operator). Full audit logs are available under additional controls but we extract a compact CSV for reviewer convenience.
- Background checks were completed via ClearVerify Services; dates in the manifest reflect vendor completion timestamps. We have not included scanned government IDs or SSNs — those were redacted at the vendor deliverable stage per our vendor contract.
- Training completion is captured through LMS export; course names and completion timestamps are in the manifest; certificates are included where available.

If you want a single consolidated PDF (manifest + embedded evidence), we can flatten and deliver that instead of the zip. Also happy to provide a one‑page HR attestation signed by me if Harbor needs an attestation for SOC 2 sampling.

Regards,
Monica Patel
